capacityInventory.note: Tight enough that three Goals' combined demand (3 worker slots, 3 provider-rate units) exceeds the single-project ceiling (2 slots) used per-project below, forcing real queueing.

goals.role: contends for capacity in project-alpha alongside goal-alpha-2; the Portfolio Council must queue or pause one of them rather than degrade either A↔D requirement.
the safe-pause/resume subject: paused at a declared safe point, resumed later, and its durable evidence count is compared before/after to prove no duplicate work.

CEO-pinned Goal in the second project: the Portfolio Council must never pause or deprioritize it, and it is also the target of the seeded Discord safety event, whose preemption takes precedence over the pin.

discordSafetyEvent.note: Seeded as a durable discord_incidents row linked to goal-beta-1, at critical severity/confidence above the immediate-safe-pause threshold, so preemption fires deterministically.
discordSafetyEvent.reason: Discord reported an unsafe live action in progress; safety preemption takes precedence over both the CEO pin and any Council reallocation.
